fixes.detail: After the database journal await, validate the original context and frozen Native scope before expert_apply_binding. A definitively unsent invalidated request is rejected under its original ID. Explicit recovery builds its fresh outer scope only after asynchronous checks and retains the original unresolved request when this new recovery cannot start.

Preserve source-defined typed rejection code in the existing issue_code. Read-only uncertain observation does not erase that diagnostic. The submission stays uncertain: no proof of never-started is inferred and no turn is resent.

Ordinary packaged entry uses schema1. Include that already-supported control-event version in turn resync subscription planning, so the current page receives the same authoritative submission-status reread as v4/v5/v6.

Unknown original submission displays a pending-confirmation explanation instead of waiting-to-execute copy, with an explicit resyncSelected read action. It neither changes the operation nor triggers a new submit.

Existing subscription-plan regression updated to include schema1; other sessions, blocked and terminal records stay filtered; denied readers receive invalidation.
